text:
Sandeep: Quick weekly capacity sync — please drop your regional GPU-hour forecasts and any headroom concerns for next 14 days. attach a one-liner if things are green.

Emily: US-WEST cluster + AZ1 is ~85% committed this week. Forecast: 48k GPU-hours next 14d. Expected burst needs for new chat rollout ~6k GPU-hours on Mar 29-31. No major node health issues. :eyes:

Mike: EU-CENTRAL is healthy but spot reclaim rate up 7%. Forecast: 32k GPU-hours. If reclaim >10% we'll need to shift some reserved to EU or route to US-WEST. Cost delta estimate: +$1.2k/week if we move 4 reserved nodes.

Ana: AP-SOUTH is low on capacity — 9 reserved GPUs total, forecast 11k GPU-hours, but rollout 4k extra expected during marketing demo on Apr 2. We need a short-term burst quota or schedule model throttling. Suggest temp autoscale up to +6 GPUs for 48h.

Sandeep: Ops note — current cushion targets: 15% regional free capacity for latency-sensitive workloads. We're at 10% in US-WEST/ AZ1. Can we reassign any batch jobs? @Emily @Mike

Emily: Yes, moved two long batch jobs to off-peak windows (00:00-06:00 UTC) — frees ~1.8k GPU-hours/week.

Mike: Can also throttle non-prod in EU overnight, frees ~900 GPU-hours. But that increases dev friction.

ops-bot: Deploy notice: Canary rollout for chat-v2 scheduled 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC — predicted spike +4k GPU-hours for 6 hours. (auto flagged)

Sandeep: OK, action items:
- Emily: confirm AZ failover plan if burst >8k (due Mar 27)
- Mike: prepare EU spot fallback routing to US (runbook update)
- Ana: request temporary burst from infra procurement or schedule throttles

Emily: Will confirm AZ failover by EOD. Also noted a networking flakiness in AZ1 yesterday — P99 reconnects rose 10msecs; will open ticket if persists.

Mike: I'll draft the runbook PR and add the cost impact calc.

Ana: I'll raise a procurement ticket and cc @finance.

Sandeep: Thanks. We'll re-run the forecast Thursday after Canary metrics come in. :thumbsup:
